desc: SLS Puerto Madero is considered one of the best hotels in Argentina, famous for hosting celebrities given its welcoming reception and pleasant stay visitors enjoy. The hotel in Buenos Aires has fully equipped rooms, buffet breakfasts, restaurant and bar (24 hours), WIFI, laundry services, gym, sauna, etc. All SLS Puerto Madero services are first class, not to mention the wonderful panoramic view.

desc: Surrounded by tourist attractions, Sofitel Buenos Aires Recoleta is a luxurious 5-star hotel that brings an authentic experience to your stay. The rooms are comfortable, and the suites have views of Recoleta. All air-conditioned and with free WiFi. ALMA BUENOS AIRES restaurant specializes in locally sourced seasonal meats and vegetables. Plus, take advantage of the pool, sauna, massage lounge, and modern event rooms…

desc: Novotel Buenos Aires is a hotel with an incredible structure, located in the heart of the fascinating city of Buenos Aires, capital of Argentina. Its modern and cozy rooms offer the perfect space for a comfortable and relaxing stay after a day exploring the city. With a variety of amenities, such as an outdoor swimming pool, well-equipped fitness center and rejuvenating spa, guests can enjoy an unforgettable…

desc: Located in the heart of Buenos Aires, our hotel offers you complete comfort in its spacious apartment-style rooms. You'll have the option to enjoy breakfast with us, if you'd like. Just steps from Plaza San Martín, the Obelisk, and Recoleta, it's your best choice for a stay in the city. Book at ALL.ACCOR.COM

desc: Enjoy an incredible stay at ibis Buenos Aires Congreso, with breakfast included and a great variety of food. Delicious buffet lunches, in addition to that we have a free WIFI network. In addition, children under 12 have no extra charge for their stay. We have a reception desk ready to assist you in different languages and we also accept pets. Its location provides ample access to different neighborhoods.

name: ibis Styles Buenos Aires Florida
desc: The 3-star ibis Styles Buenos Aires Florida is the ideal hotel for staying in the capital. It is attractively decorated, based on local theaters and historic buildings. With functional, air-conditioned rooms, free WIFI, for couples, families or singles. It also has a restaurant service where you will find breakfast, lunch and dinner, and a bar with sandwiches and snacks. This hotel is pet-friendly.

A serene space that awakens the senses and immerses you in an atmosphere that transcends design aesthetics. Enjoy high quality service, personalized attention and warmth in every detail, complemented by elegant spaces, exquisite cuisine and…

desc: Hotel ibis Mendoza not only has an excellent location in the city center, but also offers a great experience in Mendoza. This hotel has a trilingual reception, is pet-friendly, guarantees free accommodation for children up to 12 years, parking, breakfast & restaurant. Ideal for family or couples, bedrooms are spacious, comfortable and equipped for a great stay. Enjoy this incredible experience.

name: ibis Pilar
desc: The ibis Pilar is well located and ideal for your stay in the Argentinian city. Rooms have air-conditioning and free WIFI and Sweet beds that accommodate couples, singles and families. You can enjoy breakfast, lunch and dinner in the ibis Kitchen, plus afternoon tea and drinks in the bar, open 24 hours a day. Here one pet per room is allowed, and kids up to 10 with parents stay for free.

name: Ibis Puerto General San Martin
desc: Experience an unforgettable stay at a premier AccorHotels hotel. Enjoy a 24-hour bar and restaurant, breakfast buffet, free WIFI, on-site parking, and a meeting room for up to 500 people. We have rooms to accommodate families, are pet-friendly, and are co nveniently located in the province's key industrial area, just minutes from Rosario.

name: Mercure Iguazu Hotel Iru
desc: The Mercure Iguazú Hotel combines comfort and nature in a unique way. Spacious, comfortable rooms with large, air-conditioned beds and free WIFI. The restaurant features a variety of breakfast foods and the best of local and international cuisine at lunch and dinner. The pool area and Pool Bar is in a jungle setting.
address: Selva Iryapu S N, Predio 600 Has, MISIONES

name: Pullman Rosario City Center
desc: Pullman City Center Rosario has many options for your business or pleasure stay. Rooms and suites are comfortable, air-conditioned, with minibars and free WIFI. Le Gula has a variety of dishes. Relax at the pool with bar, massage parlors and beauty salons. Use the business center and meeting rooms for large events, while the kids enjoy the kids space. Enjoy the complex housing the hotel, with the casino.
address: Av Batlle y Ordoñez y Bv Oroño, City Center

name: Mercure Rosario
desc: The 4-star superior Mercure Rosario has 20 floors and 140 rooms overlooking the Paraná River, cutting-edge technology and minimalist design, offering comforts that today's traveler wants. Don't miss the sunset at our RoofTop on the 20th floor, and see the city's architecture and Paraná River. Following current trends, it has 20 co-working offices to offer business guests a unique, dedicated space.

name: Mercure Santa Rosa La Pampa
desc: The Mercure Santa Rosa La Pampa is perfect for a pleasant stay, whether for business or leisure. The rooms are beautifully designed, comfortable and air-conditioned, with free WiFi and the option of a whirlpool tub. Enjoy delicious meals at the Bacanal Lobby Bar. The hotel also features conference rooms, a business center, an outdoor pool with a sun deck and a fitness center.
address: Av Santiago Marzo N 25, Interseccion Ruta 5 Y 35
